clips.title: The story
paras: The Legend of Stalvan begins in Darkshire with a foreboding vision from the town diviner, Madame Eva. Disturbed by an omen portending death for her granddaughter Alyssa, Eva draws upon her cards and trance visions to divine a single lingering name: Stalvan. To untangle this thread of dread, she sends travelers to consult town records in the Darkshire Town Hall.

In the perpetual gloom of Duskwood, Madame Eva serves as Darkshire's resident seer, interpreting portents and reading cards for troubled locals. After being jolted awake by a terrible disturbance, Eva consulted her divination deck, only to draw the Death card in connection to her young granddaughter, Alyssa. Falling into a deep, shadowy trance to pierce the gloom, she pulled forth only a single clue: the name Stalvan. Terrified of what this omen means for her family and the town, she turns to capable adventurers to follow the thread before tragedy strikes.

Eva knows that uncovering the truth of Stalvan requires looking into Darkshire's written history. She directs adventurers across the square to the Darkshire Town Hall to speak with Clerk Daltry, the municipal keeper of ledgers and public archives. Daltry oversees the township's dusty documents, making him the only person capable of determining whether Stalvan was a former resident, a traveler passing through, or something far more sinister buried in Duskwood's past.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins. I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger. I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.
After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery. A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.
Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character. I fear for us all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah so Madame Eva sent you....
